description: This file defines a React component called ExecutionStatusBar which displays execution details, status icons, duration, and action buttons for a workflow execution in a web UI. It imports UI icons, hooks, utility functions, and subcomponents, and manages rendering based on execution state.

classes.name: ExecutionStatusBarProps
classes.description: TypeScript interface defining the props for the ExecutionStatusBar component, including an execution object and an optional onBack callback.

methods.name: StatusIcon
methods.description: A React functional component that returns an icon representing the normalized status of an execution, with appropriate theme styling.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Utility function to convert a duration in milliseconds to a human-readable string format.

methods.name: ExecutionStatusBar
methods.description: Main React component that displays execution details, status icon, duration, and action buttons, with internal handlers for retry and share actions.
